title.narrative: Desk appraisal af støtte til Rom processen...

description.narrative:
The objective of the desk appraisal is to provide quality-assurance of the Project Document and its related material.
The desk appraisal will be used for consideration of adjustments to the Project Document with the aim of assuring the best possible base for the activities to be carried out under the project.
The Rome Process/Mattei Plan Financing Facility (RPFF) is a multi-donor facility managed by the AfDB, established to tackle the root causes of migration and displacement through strategic, climate-aligned investments in infrastructure. The RPFF stems from the Rome Process, launched at the Rome Conference on 23 July 2023, initiated by Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni and Tunisian President Kaïs Saïed. The Process brought together leaders from African, Middle Eastern, and European countries, including from the broader Mediterranean region, alongside international institutions, to forge a new development-oriented approach to addressing irregular migration.
